C0480.title: MPS Criminal Investigation Bureau Warns Against 'Points Expiration' Scams
C0480.summary: In June 2025, China's Ministry of Public Security Criminal Investigation Bureau issued 20 anti-fraud keywords, listing 'points expiration' as a common scam tactic. Fraudsters typically lure victims by claiming points are about to expire, tricking them into clicking phishing links to carry out fraud.
